summary: Reports a family of algorithms for retrieving large tables of management data with SNMP more efficiently than asking for one item at a time. It is an Experimental document that shares the ideas and invites discussion rather than defining a standard.

eli5.summary: Instead of asking a librarian for one book at a time, you ask for a whole shelf at once. This explores ways to do that for network gadgets.

questions: how to retrieve large tables with snmp
what is snmp bulk table retrieval
